root.label: CrowdJustice blocks Palestine Action Supreme Court fundraiser

events.label: CrowdJustice blocks Palestine Action Supreme Court fundraiser

slots.name: fundraiser status
slots.sentence: An online crowdfunder to raise money for the UK supreme court challenge to the ban on Palestine Action has been blocked as a result of US sanctions against the direct action group.

slots.sentence: “On the other hand, the state continues to spend millions of pounds to cover their legal costs to defend the disproportionate and draconian ban, which has led to more than 3,700 arrests for holding signs [allegedly supporting a proscribed organisation].
